notes.title: UZZU Endgame and content update!
notes.notes:
Hello cosmic friends! We are pleased to announce some new exciting content for Flewfie's Adventure!

Your spaceship now has a "Special" meter, which can be seen under your health bar. When this meter is full, you can use a special explosive attack to deal some serious damage to nearby enemies! This can be an absolute game changer in tricky situations, use it wisely and become a flying cat legend :)

Did you beat the game yet? Hmmm... Well, something mischievous may await at the end! .... Uzzu?! What are you doing? Take a look at our new trailer to see a preview of some new levels at the end of the game! :)

Flewfie's Adventure is also coming to console on 1st June! Keep your eye out for those being released!

Thank you so much!

notes.title: 1.04 Patch notes
notes.notes:
- Able to tweak music/SFX settings more (5, 10, 15% etc)
- Shortcut dialogue for tinkz/tinka/bunnbunn so you don't have to speak to them loads each time you want to customize
- Fixed a bug where Crystal Lvl 5 would always be unlocked

notes.title: Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes: We have been working very hard to add lot's of content into the game over the past few months, and we are very excited to announce that we will be releasing Flewfie's Adventure on Thursday the 23rd of September!
